task: Independent Edulytiks assessment: your class has 24 learners; each is assumed to drink 18 cubic inches of milk per day. Estimate and explain daily consumption and days to consume 43,200 cubic inches, stating that these are hypothetical numbers.
answer: 24×18=432 cubic inches/day;43200÷432=100 days under the stated assumptions.
criteria: teacher reviews reasoning and alternative estimates
